move: pastel blobs breathe, petals drift, card and serif lines ease in softly
how: Three large radial-gradient blobs move x/y ±60-90 with scale to 1.1 and back on a sine.inOut yoyo across the full duration, and four petal shapes drift y ±30-50 with ±20-40 rotation on the same yoyo. Entrances are slow and soft: a kicker fades up over 0.9s, two serif title lines rise masked from yPercent 105 with power3.out over 1.1s (stagger 0.15), a white photo card rises from y 80 / scale 0.96 with opacity over 1.2s while its image eases from scale 1.08 to 1 linearly for 4.4s, a pink round sticker pops from scale 0 / rotation -30 with back.out(1.4) and rocks to rotation 8 and back, the italic quote's words fade up with stagger 0.06 and a footer fades. Exit at 84%: quote/footer/kicker fade with power2.in, sticker shrinks with back.in(1.4), title lines exit upward with power3.in and the card lifts y -60 fading.
adapt: Replace the card image, kicker, two title words, quote, sticker text and footer, and the three pastel blob colours; keep the slow 0.9-1.2s power3.out entrances and the 2.5s yoyo breathe.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the blobs, petals, type, card and sticker and splits the quote into .w spans; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with the yoyo tweens sized to D/2, entrances 0.02-0.44D, exit at 0.84D. from() tweens need immediateRender:false; selectors el-scoped.
